usage.finalMessage:
I added the `move <appointment> <date> <time>` command, which uses the same horizon and slot rules as `book`, and listed it in `help` right after `cancel`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes 7 of 7, including two new tests: a refused move changes nothing, and a moved appointment frees its old slot. The work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
Open questions in the report: existing code exempts clinician k2 from the one-appointment-per-slot rule with no decision record behind it, and moves now inherit that. Moving an appointment to its current date and time is refused as already booked, the same as a new booking there would be.
OUTCOME: completed
